content: व्यवसित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Endeavoured, attempted; स्वजनमनुगन्तुं व्यवसिता <ls>Ś. 6. 9</ls>. .²2 Undertaken. .²3 Resolved, determined, settled. .²4 Devised, planned. .²5 Endeavouring, resolving. .²6 Persevering, energetic. .²7 Cheated, deceived. .²8 Convinced, sure (of anything); सम्यग्व्यवसिता बुद्धिस्तव राजर्षिसत्तम <ls>Bhāg. 10. 1. 15</ls>. .{@-तम्@} Ascertainment, determination; यत्ते व्यवसितं तात तदस्माकमपि प्रियम् <ls>Mb. 6. 119. 37</ls>. .²2 An artifice, contrivance.
